steward_gate.rule: Structural CI proves only that the exact candidate satisfies the trusted repository-side Steward structure contract. It never authorizes merge by itself. The single Main Steward must independently refresh live main, exact candidate head, required platform statuses, substantive exact-head review completion, unresolved findings and incident state immediately before an expected-head guarded merge, then verify resulting main. Open incidents fail closed unless their durable incident record explicitly declares a NON_BLOCKING scope. Receipt prefixes must be normalized directory boundaries. The first Steward-gate bootstrap cannot trust a base checker or base-owned workflow that does not yet exist, publishes no trusted Steward status, and therefore requires explicit live Steward review plus the ordinary exact-head platform proof.

external_enforcement.desired: After Steward-gate bootstrap, GitHub branch protection or a repository ruleset should require the three exact-head platform contexts plus the trusted n0te2-steward-structure context where administratively available.
external_enforcement.current_truth: Repository policy and trusted structural CI define evidence requirements, while the single active Main Steward remains the live merge-authorization owner unless external branch protection or ruleset evidence proves equivalent atomic enforcement. A structural status, including green, is not a merge receipt.
